notes:
**Residents:** INS 2021 Population and Housing Census, total population per UAT (6 Bucharest sectors + 40 Ilfov towns/communes; totals 1,716,961 and 542,704, checked against the county totals). Spread over Overture building footprints (OSM-tagged where available) by residential floor area = footprint × floors (OSM building:levels/height, Overture height, otherwise generic defaults by building type: large blocs 8 floors, apartments 5, houses 1.5).

**Jobs:** no per-area workplace data used. Trip destinations = 62% of residents (workers + commuting students), split 83% Bucharest / 17% Ilfov from INS county employee counts (2025-26). Within each county, placed by building-type floor area with generic job densities (office, retail, mall, industrial, warehouse, education, health, public, hotel) plus OSM shop/office/amenity POIs, then adjusted by hand-tuned zone multipliers for known business districts (Pipera, Floreasca, Băneasa, A1/DN2 logistics, Titan/Republica) and residential estates.

**Flows:** no measured O/D. Doubly-constrained gravity model (exponential decay, Furness balancing, calibrated to a 9.5 km mean trip) against the resident and destination totals above, sampled into pops ≤200. Driving times from OSRM on OSM.

**Special demand (unscored):** airport, universities, malls, stadium, convention centre, parks, hospitals added with depot add_points; visitor/student figures are author estimates.

Vintages: census 2021, employee totals 2025-26, OSM/Overture 2026. Pipeline: https://github.com/naealexandru95-del/sb-bucharest-ilfov
